rules: ELIGIBLE requires direct-live official Planning Data entity readback, blank end-date, official POINT, positive dwelling capacity and confidence >=98
Search snippets/tables alone never promote a row
Material structured-vs-notes capacity conflicts are excluded
Notes-only capacity and lapsed/withdrawn permission caveats are excluded under this wave's stricter >=98 gate
Historical end-date, zero capacity, missing official point, cache-miss and timeout are excluded
Planning Data POINT is source location only and never a canonical parcel polygon
